notes: Samsung prints Dimension & Weight as WIDTH x HEIGHT x DEPTH; mapped to height/width/depth accordingly. Samsung never publishes a crease shape (teardrop/U) for any Flip, so hinge.crease is null throughout. hinge.max_angle_deg left null: Samsung states Flex Mode working angles, not a maximum hinge angle. hinge.free_stop is NULL for Flip6 specifically: neither the Samsung global newsroom release nor the Samsung Mobile Press version of it contains the string 'Flex Mode' anywhere (they market FlexWindow and FlexCam instead), so there is no OEM statement of free-stop positioning for this generation to cite. Flip5 and Flip7/Flip8 releases DO document Flex Mode, so those are true.
